correctness.rationale: Direct polar differentiation and an exact decreasing primitive give the conserved C and all periodic orbits. Uniform physical-time phase implies the complete arccos survival function. Taylor inversion at the unique critical phase, two-sided quadratic bounds, gamma beta integral, and controlled borderline error prove the sharp tail and all-real-order moment trichotomy. The p=2 area is the exact polar area integral. Symbolic derivative and standalone numerical checks matched.

A cubic global-center occupation result addresses a different ODE and a distinct first moment cutoff.

value.rationale: The natural problem of what a physical-time observer sees near a quartic isochronous period annulus boundary is quantitatively unanswered by existing phase-portrait classifications: a nontrivial heavy-tail law with universal leading coefficient, a sharp 3/2 moment transition, and precise divergent area coexist with constant period 2π. The full one-orbit occupation distribution and exact constants, rather than an arbitrary numerical slice, are the claim.
